# BuriKaigi Brief

Conference-specific knowledge for the generic proposal agents (`Orchestrator`, `Writer`, `Reviewer`). Generic definitions stay reusable; everything BuriKaigi-specific lives here. Pass this file as the conference brief per task.

## Event

- BuriKaigi 2027, 2027-01-08 (Fri) - 2027-01-09 (Sat), offline. (verified: <https://burikaigi.dev/> , <https://burikaigi.dev/news/2026-10-10/>)
- Venue: Toyama International Conference Center, 1-2 Otemachi, Toyama-shi, Toyama. (verified: <https://burikaigi.dev/>)

## Submission Rules (verified: <https://fortee.jp/burikaigi-2027/speaker/proposal/cfp>)

- Theme: no restriction if IT-related; academic fish-ecology content out of scope.
- One session = 30 min slot.
- Joint presentations allowed.
- Multiple submissions allowed; in principle one acceptance per speaker.
- Fair review with first-time-speaker consideration and de-duplication.
- Result by email; no individual feedback on reasons.
- No travel support or honorarium.

## Submission Fields (UNVERIFIED)

- Live fortee form field names, character limits, voice, selectors vs free text are UNVERIFIED (form requires login). Do not carry over GopherCon/KubeCon field specs.
- Official recommended structure (user-provided, UNVERIFIED against live CFP fetch) — output must use exactly:

```plaintext
## 扱うテーマ / 技術要素
## 背景 / 課題設定
## このセッションで得られること
## 対象者の目安
- 前提知識:
- 対象者レベル: 初級/中級/上級
```

- Bio: human-owned. Agents never touch it.

## Speaker Constraints on File

- Eligible format for 2027: 30-min session only. (verified: <https://fortee.jp/burikaigi-2027/speaker/proposal/cfp>)
- Include a concrete 30-min timed structure; achievability is checked against the slot.
- No invited-talk / workshop eligibility via this CFP.

## Review Criteria (verified: <https://fortee.jp/burikaigi-2027/speaker/proposal/cfp>)

- Broad entry + deep dive balance: reviewers favor wide-target settings even for maniacal topics.
- Practical depth: performance work, architecture, implementation-level knowledge, on-site struggles.
- "Tried / investigated / built" reports welcome, including early-career attempts.
- Simple and clear over highly difficult; enjoyable for beginners through advanced.
- Language-agnostic; no single-stack bias.

## Audience

- Multi-domain, multi-context, beginner to advanced. Not Go-specific (unlike GopherCon/Go Conference). Set prerequisites explicitly and keep entry broad. (inferred from reviewer comments: <https://fortee.jp/burikaigi-2027/speaker/proposal/cfp>)

## Notes from Past Acceptance (`2026/BuriKaigi/proposal_1.md`)

- Friendly direct address opening; Why/What before How.
- Explicit target, inclusions/exclusions, timed outline totaling 30 min.
- Quantitative production hook + closing explanation of the hook.
- Go-specific mechanisms explained via history; implementation detail explicitly excluded.
- Credibility via prior talk recording link; next-step past sessions listed.

## Strictness

- Medium. Limited slots; de-duplication and balance matter more than fee-based exclusivity. First-timer consideration exists.

## Standing Exceptions

- None verified. If live form mandates voice/case/limits, live form wins; record as new exception then.

## Maintenance

- Edition-specific facts (dates, venue, CFP URLs, slot length) live under Event and must be refreshed per edition; the rest applies BuriKaigi-wide until the live CFP contradicts it.
